profile.name: Babalola Unique Samuel
bioParagraphs: I’m a creative strategist and product marketer who enjoys turning ideas into brands, campaigns, and experiences that people can actually connect with. My background cuts across design, branding, content, digital marketing, and media, with experience working across fintech, renewable energy, telecommunications, and social impact.

I’m big on simple, relatable ideas that evoke emotion and leave a lasting impression. I currently work in product marketing while building Hybrident, a creative consultancy where I bring strategy, creativity, and execution together to help brands communicate better and grow.
